abort.already_configured: This BUSY Bar is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: BUSY Bar authentication was updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: BUSY Bar configuration was updated successfully.

error.api_disabled: Wi-Fi API access is disabled. On the BUSY Bar, open Settings > Connectivity > HTTP API and turn Wi-Fi access on.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BUSY Bar. Check its address, power, and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The local API key is incorrect. Leave it blank when access mode is On, or enter the 4–10 digit key when access mode is Key.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.

user.title: Connect to a BUSY Bar
user.description: Connects directly over your local network—no BUSY cloud account is needed.

data_description.host: The BUSY Bar IP address or hostname, such as 192.168.1.50.
data_description.token: Optional 4–10 digit key from the BUSY Bar's HTTP API settings. Leave blank when Wi-Fi access is simply On.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up discovered BUSY Bar
discovery_confirm.description: A BUSY Bar was found at {host}. Confirm its address and enter the local API key only if key mode is enabled.

data_description.token: Optional 4–10 digit key from the BUSY Bar's HTTP API settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Update local API access
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current local API key. Leave it blank when access mode is On.

data_description.host: The BUSY Bar IP address or hostname.

data_description.default_priority: Built-in apps use priority 10 and an active BUSY session uses 90. Keep 50 to avoid interrupting focus sessions.
data_description.scan_interval: Fallback refresh interval in seconds; live updates also arrive over the local WebSocket.

storage_low.title: BUSY Bar storage is almost full
storage_low.description: The BUSY Bar has very little free local storage. Delete unused Home Assistant assets or other device files before uploading more media.

update_battery_low.title: Charge the BUSY Bar before updating
update_battery_low.description: A firmware update is available, but the BUSY Bar has blocked installation until its battery is sufficiently charged.

update_failed.title: BUSY Bar firmware update failed
update_failed.description: The last firmware update failed: {detail}. Check the device, then retry from its Firmware entity.

stream_unstable.title: BUSY Bar live connection is unstable
stream_unstable.description: The local WebSocket has repeatedly disconnected. State polling still works, but physical controls and screen previews may be delayed. Check LAN signal and device power.

clear_display.name: Clear display
clear_display.description: Clears only display elements owned by Home Assistant, leaving other BUSY Bar apps alone.

draw.name: Draw raw elements
draw.description: Draws advanced text, rectangle, image, animation, or countdown elements using the BUSY Bar API schema.

payload.name: Display payload
payload.description: A BUSY Bar DisplayElements object. Home Assistant supplies application_name.

clear_before_draw.name: Clear first
clear_before_draw.description: Clear Home Assistant's current elements before drawing.

play_effect.name: Play effect
play_effect.description: Plays a bounded local animation with no cloud dependency.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: One of the generated local animation styles.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Animation length in seconds, up to 30.

play_preset.name: Play household preset
play_preset.description: Plays an opinionated animation and message for a familiar household moment.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Doorbell, package, laundry, dinner, weather, bedtime, celebration, and more.

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional replacement for the friendly default message.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Sends a virtual BUSY Bar button press.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows colorful, scrolling text on the front display and can blink the status LED.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1–100. The default 50 does not interrupt an active BUSY session at 90.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to display; 0 keeps it until cleared.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Scroll text that does not fit.

show_progress.name: Show progress
show_progress.description: Shows a compact progress bar for chores, downloads, prints, and timers.

label.name: Label
label.description: Optional label; defaults to the percentage.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to display; 0 keeps it until cleared.

start_focus.name: Start focus timer
start_focus.description: Starts a one-off focus timer without changing the saved Busy or Custom profiles.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Firmware theme identifier, such as on_air or busy.

trigger_smart_home.name: Trigger smart home
trigger_smart_home.description: Emit the BUSY Bar smart-home state during this timer.

show_widget.name: Show widget
show_widget.description: Shows a friendly widget on the front or rear display and restores the previous layer afterward.

widget.name: Widget
widget.description: Message, entity, weather, calendar, countdown, clock, progress, chart, alert, streak, or scoreboard.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Optional unit appended to the value.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO timestamp required by countdown widgets.

values.name: Chart values
values.description: A list of numbers for a chart widget.

display.name: Display
display.description: Front LED matrix or rear OLED.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show the widget; zero keeps it.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Restore the previous eligible layer after expiry.

layer_id.name: Layer ID
layer_id.description: Optional stable identifier used to update a persistent widget.

play_sound.name: Play sound
play_sound.description: Plays a stock or previously uploaded sound from local device storage.

stop_sound.name: Stop sound
stop_sound.description: Stops current BUSY Bar audio playback.

set_profile.name: Set timer profile
set_profile.description: Edits the physical Busy or Custom timer profile stored on the device.

slot.name: Profile
slot.description: Busy or Custom physical switch slot.

title.name: Title
title.description: Profile title shown by the device.

work_minutes.name: Work minutes
work_minutes.description: Work phase duration for an interval timer.

rest_minutes.name: Rest minutes
rest_minutes.description: Rest phase duration for an interval timer.

show_work_only.name: Work phase only
show_work_only.description: Show busy status only during work phases.

trigger_smart_home.name: Trigger smart home
trigger_smart_home.description: Emit the emulated smart-home switch state.

check_update.name: Check for firmware updates
check_update.description: Starts the BUSY Bar's local firmware update check.

abort_update.name: Abort firmware download
abort_update.description: Stops an in-progress firmware download before installation begins.

play_game.name: Play mini-app
play_game.description: Runs a bounded local game or playful app; Pong, Snake, and Reaction use the physical controls.

mood.name: Pixel-pet mood
mood.description: Expression used by the Pixel Pet app.

stop_game.name: Stop mini-app
stop_game.description: Stops the running mini-app and restores underlying content.

show_media.name: Show media
show_media.description: Converts a Home Assistant media-source image, GIF, or video locally and shows it on the Bar.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: Image, GIF, or video from Home Assistant media sources.

display.name: Display
display.description: Front LED matrix or rear OLED.

play_media.name: Play media audio
play_media.description: Converts and plays an audio file from Home Assistant media sources.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: Audio file from Home Assistant media sources.

show_qr.name: Show QR code
show_qr.description: Generates a QR code locally and shows it on the rear OLED.

value.name: Value
value.description: Text or URL encoded into the QR code.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to show the QR code.

delete_assets.name: Delete Home Assistant assets
delete_assets.description: Deletes only media uploaded under this integration's device namespace.
